title: *CS504 – GDB SOLUTION BY SAIF CHISHTI*
text:
*CS504 – GDB SOLUTION BY SAIF CHISHTI*

*Option 1:* Yes, the design of data flows between system processes and data stores can significantly affect the consistency and accuracy of system outputs.

*Reason:* Improper design of data flows between processes and data stores is a major cause of inconsistencies in system outputs, because unnecessary intermediate processes and indirect data paths allow confirmations, duplicate records, and payment mismatches to occur without proper checks.

title: Aslam o alikum
text:
Aslam o alikum 
Cs 504 , Cs304 gdb soln chahiye
